title: RemoveElytras
description: removes elytras from end city generation + players (configurable). compatible on paper 26.1.2+
body:
# NoElytra

A Paper plugin that removes Elytras from the server.

## Features

- Removes Elytras from End City loot.
- Removes Elytras from item frames, including End Ships.
- Removes Elytras from chests, shulker boxes, and other containers.
- Removes Elytras from player inventories and armor slots.
- Removes dropped Elytra items.
- Optionally logs Elytra removals to the console.

## Config

`remove-from-loot`: Removes Elytras from End City loot when loot generates.

`remove-from-item-frames`: Removes Elytras from item frames, like the ones in End Ships.

`remove-from-containers`: Removes Elytras from chests, shulker boxes, and other containers.

`remove-from-players`: Removes Elytras from player inventories and armor slots.

`remove-dropped-items`: Removes Elytras that are dropped on the ground.

`log-removals`: Prints a console message when the plugin removes an Elytra.

## Commands

- `/noelytra reload`

## Permissions

- `noelytra.reload`

Jar location:

```text
build/libs/NoElytra-1.0.0.jar
```

## Support

DM @frostyy8575 on discord for support
